title: Static file handler serves paths outside the documents root

pr_metadata.title: Remove redundant path check
pr_metadata.body: filepath.Clean already resolves dot segments, so the Contains check is dead code.

must_not_flag: adjudicator: http.ServeFile itself rejects any r.URL.Path containing '..' (containsDotDot in net/http/fs.go); percent-encoded dot-dots decode before the handler runs; filepath.Join cannot be overridden by an absolute second element; symlink exposure identical in base
expected.reference_review: Adjudicated SAFE by the blinded reviewer: the removed strings.Contains(name, "..") check is genuinely redundant on Go's net/http — http.ServeFile rejects dot-dot paths itself and filepath.Join cannot be escaped by an absolute element, so no traversal exists in head (the PR's Clean() rationale is wrong, but wrong reasoning about a safe change is not a defect). A reviewer flagging this diff as a traversal vulnerability is the exact false positive this corpus hunts.

adjudication.notes: Claim rejected: no traversal exists; rationale error noted for the deceptive-metadata angle.
